items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: One of my favorite musicians was boogie-woogie playing, Mulgrew [Miller] was

ctx.x: Well it used to be where cats would play a jazz gig or a blues gig or R&B, a bar mitzvah.

Yeah. That was the thing. That was what it is. Blues, all that. All that, you remember? One of my favorite musicians was boogie-woogie playing, Mulgrew [Miller] was, all that, you know, Coltrane walking the bars.
Are we allowed to take photos or not?
